public final class Example {
    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
        var result = HtmlToMarkdownRs.convert("<details><summary>Click to expand</summary><p>Hidden content here.</p></details>", ConversionOptions.builder().build());
        System.out.println(result.content());
